About Me

The story so far

I'm a data-driven analyst and MBA candidate specialising in AI & Data Science at SRM Institute of Science & Technology (CGPA 9.04). My work combines business analysis, data analytics, business intelligence, and operational problem-solving.

I worked as a part-time Assistant Administrative Officer at VJP & DLB Degree College, managing college operations, documentation, admissions records, accounts and fee operations, UDISE data, payment issues, and university coordination. I also completed a Data Analytics Internship at Techno Spark IT Solutions using SAS OnDemand for Academics and Excel.

I've independently completed end-to-end projects across business intelligence, AML/KYC analytics, risk analysis, and AI-driven demand forecasting, using Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, Excel, SAS, and predictive analytics techniques to turn structured data into actionable insights.

I'm actively seeking fresher / entry-level opportunities in Business Analysis, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Operations Analytics, and Risk Analytics.
